hero.headline: Government Benefits Shouldn't Be Difficult to Find.
hero.subtext: Discover government schemes, understand your eligibility, and get application guidance in your preferred language — all in one place.

how_it_works.title: How CitizenAssist Works
how_it_works.step1_desc: Describe yourself in English, Hindi, or Punjabi, or browse schemes by category.
how_it_works.step2_desc: See transparent rule-by-rule eligibility checks with citations to official sources.
how_it_works.step3_desc: Generate personalized document checklists and visit genuine official government portals.

trust.title: Trust, Transparency & Data Integrity
trust.point1_desc: We never invent criteria, grants, or deadlines. Every single fact comes with its official government source excerpt.
trust.point2_desc: Eligibility decisions are computed strictly by audited rules, not by random generative guessing.
trust.point3_desc: CitizenAssist AI is an independent student innovation project created for GRAVITON 2026. Always confirm on official government portals.

eligibility.title: Deterministic Eligibility Checker
eligibility.subtitle: Clear, rule-level eligibility breakdown with official citations
eligibility.status_not_eligible: Not Eligible based on known criteria
eligibility.status_unknown: Insufficient Information - please complete profile fields
eligibility.disclaimer: This is an automated guidance tool and does not guarantee government approval. Final eligibility is determined by official authorities.

checklist.title: Document Preparation Checklist
checklist.subtitle: Mark documents you already possess and find where to obtain missing ones

assistant.title: Multilingual Grounded Assistant
assistant.welcome: Namaste! I can help you discover government schemes and services, check your eligibility, and prepare documents in English, Hindi, or Punjabi.
assistant.placeholder: e.g., I am a 20-year-old SC student in Punjab with family income of 2 lakh. What schemes can I apply for?
assistant.ai_off_banner: AI answers are currently in Retrieval-Only mode. Set GEMINI_API_KEY in .env to enable full generative responses.

footer.disclaimer: CitizenAssist AI is an independent hackathon innovation for GRAVITON 2026 (Problem Statement #11). Not affiliated with or endorsed by the Government of India. Always confirm criteria and apply exclusively on official government portals (.gov.in / .nic.in).
